# Reproducible-build expected hashes.
#
# Format: one entry per line.
#   <artifact-name> <target-triple-or-flavor> <b3sum-hex>
#
# Generated by `--update-expected` on the verify-* scripts at tag time. Lines
# that begin with `#` are comments; blank lines are ignored. Hashes are over the
# stripped release binary (rageterm), the `pkg/ragemanifest_bg.wasm` (ragemanifest),
# or the unsigned APK contents (ragedroid -- the APK's entries are re-emitted
# sorted, with constant timestamps and without the signing block, and that
# normalized archive is what gets hashed; see normalize_apk in
# verify-ragedroid.sh).
#
# Updating: run any verify script with `--update-expected` after a tagged release
# to regenerate this file. The release CI job runs the full sweep automatically
# and uploads this file as a release artifact for transparency.
#
# THIS TABLE IS CURRENTLY EMPTY, AND THAT IS A FAILING STATE, NOT A PASSING ONE.
# No release has been cut from a build we can vouch for, so there is no honest
# hash to write down here. Every verify-* script therefore exits 1 with "no
# expected hash recorded" until a row exists. Do not "fix" a red repro job by
# running `--update-expected` on whatever happens to be in ./target -- that just
# blesses an arbitrary local build as the reference forever. Seed a row only
# from a build you have independently established is the artifact you intend to
# publish.
